notes.title: Stellar Witch Patch 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued interest in Stellar Witch.
This minor patch includes simple display error fixes and intuitive improvements.

[olist]
[*]Fixed the maximum damage display error for Hellfire. (Reflecting indirect Hellfire buff due to burn effect enhancement)
[*]Added category tag icons next to the price of each constellation in the shop. We hope this helps you purchase items that match your desired build.
[/olist]

notes.title: Stellar Witch Patch 1.2.0
notes.notes: [p]Your unwavering passion and feedback for [i]Stellar Witch[/i] continue to inspire us! Patch 1.2.0 brings exciting new features and enhancements to elevate your cosmic battles to new heights.[/p][h2]New Features[/h2][h3]Endless Mode Ranking Leaderboard[/h3][list][*][p]Compete with players worldwide! A ranking leaderboard has been added to track your performance in Endless Mode.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Damage Meter[/h3][list][*][p]Track your combat prowess with a new damage meter, displaying real-time damage output during battles.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Achievements[/h3][list][*][p]Two new achievements have been added.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for fueling the magic of [i]Stellar Witch[/i]. Your support drives us to make every starlit adventure unforgettable![/p]

notes.title: Stellar Witch Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes: [p]Your incredible support and enthusiasm for [i]Stellar Witch[/i] light up our universe! Patch 1.1.0 arrives with new features, gameplay tweaks, and polished interfaces to make your journey through the stars even more magical.[/p][h2]Constellation Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Burn Buffs[/b] (Hope you’re ready to feel the heat!):[/p][list][*][p]Burn max stack increased to 50, boosting Hellfire’s max damage to 455.[/p][/*][*][p]Fire Bolt, Fire Ball, Flaming Sword, and Lava Blade now apply 2 Burn stacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Cursed Doll’s Burn stack application reduced to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Burn damage no longer affected by Mark effect, fixing an issue where Mark was consumed per second by Burn.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Barrier-Related Summon Rework[/b] (Please show some love to our Rhinoceros Beetle too..):[/p][list][*][p]When multiple Barriers are acquired, the highest value now replaces the previous one, and the remaining amount is treated as "consumed" (previously, it disappeared but wasn’t processed as consumed). This significantly increases the amount of Barrier consumed.[/p][/*][*][p]Turtle no longer consumes Barrier.[/p][/*][*][p]Rhinoceros Beetle’s pupa state and charge time limit have been removed. Instead, it automatically activates when all Barrier is lost. Maintain your Barrier to unleash the most powerful projectile![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Armor Adjustments[/b] (Sorry, Armor, you’re too fancy for the common folk now!):[/p][list][*][p]Armor upgraded to Legendary tier, with price increased to 10 Gold and cooldown set to 10 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Planet Tag Addition[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Mana Turret and Mana AI now have the Planet tag.[/p][/*][*][p]Mana Turret no longer triggers another Mana Turret in specific situations.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Miscellaneous Changes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Changed the star positions of Healing Totem and Flaming Sword.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]New Features[/h2][h3]Save System(Steam Cloud Sync)[/h3][list][*][p][b]What’s Saved[/b]: Progress including Gold, Lives, Stage, Endless Mode, Difficulty, and placed constellations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]How to Save[/b]: Use the Settings Menu to exit or return to the Title Screen, or save during battle via the Defeat panel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]How to Load[/b]: Select "Continue" on the Title Screen if a Steam Cloud save exists.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Achievements[/h3][list][*][p]Added new achievements:[/p][list][*][p]Clear Endless Mode Stage 1[/p][/*][*][p]Deal 1000+ damage in a single hit[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Localization Updates[/h2][list][*][p]Added support for Traditional Chinese and Russian languages.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Gameplay Updates[/h2][h3]Endless Mode Refinements[/h3][list][*][p]Bosses get progressively stronger.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Stage-Based Gold Rewards Adjustment[/h3][list][*][p]Gold rewards per stage have been updated:[/p][list][*][p]Stages 1–4: 14 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Stages 5–8: 15 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Stages 9–10: 16 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Endless Mode: 16 Gold[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]User Interface Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added current stage number display[/p][/*][*][p]Show Endless Mode stage number in Endless Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Display heart icon on Stage 4 when a heart is added[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the damage display color for better visibility.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for being the heart of [i]Stellar Witch[/i]. Your feedback fuels our passion to keep crafting a stellar experience![/p]

notes.title: [Play Data Collection End Notice]
notes.notes: [p] Hello, this is the \[Stellar Witch] team.[/p][p] First, we sincerely thank all players who actively participated in the gameplay data collection from July 25th to August 1st. Your valuable play logs will be used as essential resources for improving game quality and creating a more enjoyable gaming experience. [/p][p] Today, August 1st, 2025, all gameplay log collection has concluded. Moving forward, we will thoroughly analyze the collected data and actively apply it to various aspects including game system improvements, balance adjustments, and content additions. We will return with an even better version soon, so please look forward to it![/p][p] Your continued interest and support provide great strength to our development. Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: Stellar Witch Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes: [p]We’re deeply grateful for your unwavering support and valuable feedback for [i]Stellar Witch[/i]. Patch 1.0.3 is here, bringing key fixes and balance tweaks to elevate your stellar journey![/p][p][/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Chinese Localization Fix[/b]: We've addressed issues with the Chinese localization. We sincerely apologize for any shortcomings in the previous translations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Constellation Balancing[/b]: Reduced the healing amount of the Heart Constellation and Big Heart Constellation upgrades to 7.[/p][/*][*][p][b]War Totem Fix[/b]: Resolved an issue where the War Totem was too large and overflowed the shop slot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Miscellaneous Constellation Descriptions[/b]: Further refined and updated various constellation descriptions for clarity and immersion.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We remain dedicated to improving [i]Stellar Witch[/i] and value your ongoing feedback and support as we continue this journey together![/p]

notes.title: Stellar Witch Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes: [p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback for [i]Stellar Witch[/i]. This patch brings some exciting updates and improvements to enhance your experience as you journey through the stars![/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Starting Staff[/b]: Players now begin the game equipped with a single staff, ensuring you’re never left empty-handed on the battlefield![/p][/*][*][p][b]Constellation Descriptions[/b]: Clarified and refined the descriptions for several constellations to provide better understanding and immersion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial Improvements[/b]: Enhanced the tutorial to offer a smoother and more intuitive introduction to the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’re committed to making [i]Stellar Witch[/i] the best it can be, and we appreciate your ongoing support and feedback![/p]

notes.title: Stellar Witch Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes: [p]We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all the players for your support and feedback as we continue to improve [i]Stellar Witch[/i]. This patch addresses some key issues and introduces a significant boss update to enhance your gameplay experience.[/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Boss Rework: One More Time[/b][/p][list][*][p]Integrated the most engaging patterns from previous bosses for a more dynamic challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]Note: The "One More Time" boss appears after clearing the main game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Constellation Description Update[/b][/p][p]Added an explanation of the [i]Freeze[/i] effect to constellation descriptions that apply the [i]Frostbite[/i] status.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing the ESC key during loading would cause the settings menu to not open after screen transition.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a UI issue where the probability table was not displaying for the "One More Time" boss.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your continued support as we work to make [i]Stellar Witch[/i] even better![/p]

notes.title: Stellar Witch is Now Available!
notes.notes: [p]We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Stellar Witch[/i], our inventory management dodge battler, is now available to purchase on Steam![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687228/25a88aa7a39ee0336662f32dfe7f790682f95e08.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What's in the Game?[/h3][p][b]Constellation Crafting[/b][/p][p]Forge your own cosmic battlefield in [i]Stellar Witch[/i] by arranging constellations to create a personalized field that shapes your strategy and powers.[/p][p][b]Dodge-Driven Combat[/b][/p][p]Navigate thrilling battles with skillful evasion, where precise dodging is key to outsmarting enemies and progressing through the cosmos.[/p][p][/p][h3]Feedback, Bugs, and Community[/h3][p]Join our community on [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3822990/discussions/"]here[/url] to share your thoughts, report bugs, or suggest new features. Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to shape [i]Stellar Witch[/i]! Stay tuned for our upcoming roadmap based on your input.[/p][p]Embark on your magical adventure and conquer the cosmos in [i]Stellar Witch[/i]![/p][p][/p][h3]Temporary Log Collection Notice (First Week Only)[/h3][p]To help balance the game and ensure stability, we will be collecting gameplay logs—[b]with your consent[/b]—for one week following the launch. This data will be used strictly for improvement purposes only and will not contain any personally identifiable information. For more details, please refer to our [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3822990/view/520845543638828964"]Privacy Policy[/url].[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Privacy Policy for "Stellar Witch"
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][b]Last Updated: July 22, 2025[/b][/p][p]Bae-Ma-Ru@Gyul-Sok ("the Company," "we," "us," or "our") values your privacy and complies with all relevant laws and regulations. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.[/p][p][b]1. Information We Collect[/b] The Company collects the following information to provide game services:[/p][list][*][p][b]Information Collected Automatically:[/b] Gameplay records (e.g., stage clears, constellation usage), device information (e.g., OS version, device model), error information, and an anonymized player identifier (Unity Player ID).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]2. Purpose of Collection and Use of Personal Information[/b] The Company uses the collected information for the following purposes:[/p][list][*][p]Game balancing and content improvement.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixing and service stabilization.[/p][/*][*][p]Statistical analysis of user engagement patterns.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]3. Data Retention and Use Period[/b] The Company will promptly destroy personal information once the purpose of its collection and use has been achieved. However, if retention is required by relevant laws and regulations, we will store the information for a specified period. In general, data is retained for 13 months from the date of collection.[/p][p][b]4. Sharing Personal Information with Third Parties[/b] To provide seamless services, the Company provides personal information to the external specialized company listed below:[/p][list][*][p][b]Recipient:[/b] Unity Technologies[/p][/*][*][p][b]Information Provided:[/b] Anonymized player identifier, gameplay records, device information.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Purpose of Provision:[/b] Statistical analysis of game usage (Unity Analytics service).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Retention and Use Period:[/b] In accordance with the privacy policy of the respective company.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]5. User Rights and How to Exercise Them[/b] Users may request the deletion of their personal information at any time. For data deletion requests, please contact us at the email address below.[/p][p][b]6. Changes to the Privacy Policy[/b] Any additions, deletions, or modifications to this Privacy Policy will be announced through a notice at least 7 days prior to the effective date.[/p][p][b]7. Contact Information[/b] For any inquiries or requests related to personal information, please contact us at:[/p][list][*][p][b]Email: [/b] [url="https://6767anine@gmail.com"]6767anine@gmail.com[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
